en: A sepia-tone photograph depicting a tranquil waterside scene, with a group of men in colonial-era rowing attire in a long boat near the shore, alongside two children standing in the shallow water. In the background, a large sailboat is anchored. Some text in red is printed on the right margin, including the words 'Praia,' '106. Loanda,' and publishing information at the bottom.
